tools.name: NFL Lines Tracker
tools.tagline: Every NFL line from open to close, stripped of the bookmaker's margin and merged into one fair price.
tools.summary: Reads six major U.S. sportsbooks and two prediction exchanges, removes the bookmaker's margin from each price, and averages what is left into a consensus fair line. Every game is charted from open to close, graded against its closing line, and annotated with the injury news that landed while the line moved.
highlights: Margin-free consensus line: each price converted to a probability, the vig removed, the books averaged and converted back
Spread and moneyline charted from open to close on one time axis
Injury news pinned to the chart at the moment it broke, with the move that followed
Every game graded against its closing line, plus a 19-market futures board tracked week over week
Follow a game: alerts when its line moves past a set threshold or key injury news hits
Referee assignment on every game with that referee's historical over, under and cover tendencies
tools.image_alt: Lines Tracker: every NFL game with its opening, current and closing line

tools.name: NFL Injury Tracker
tools.tagline: The league-wide injury report with a full change history, start dates and betting line impact.
tools.summary: Polls the full NFL injury report on a schedule that tightens near kickoff, keeps an append-only history of every designation change, and flags the injuries that came just before a betting line move. Built to tell real news from feed noise: a status that flickers between two equivalent designations is damped, not reported as news.
highlights: Full report read every 30 minutes, and every 10 within two hours of a kickoff
Append-only history: when each injury began, its latest update and every status change
Line-moving flag when an impact player's news came within a day before a move of a point or more
Flicker damping so a feed alternating between equivalent statuses does not file false changes
A second source fills in long-term injured players the primary report drops past its per-team cap
Filters by team, game, starters and every position, with the offensive line and each defensive spot broken out
tools.image_alt: Injury Tracker: the league-wide report with start dates and status changes

tools.name: NFL Depth Charts with Madden Ratings
tools.tagline: All 32 depth charts, offense and defense, with contracts, acquisition history and Madden ratings.
tools.summary: Rebuilds every NFL depth chart four times a day, offense by position and defense by alignment spot, and attaches each player's acquisition path, current contract, injury status and Madden NFL 27 overall rating. The attributes behind each rating are ranked by a regression fitted to every rated player at each position.
highlights: Offense by position, defense by alignment spot (edge, nose, linebacker, corner, nickel) and the kicker
Acquisition for every player: draft round and year, free agent signing or trade
Contract column with salary and term, with rookie deals and practice squad labeled where no figure is published
Madden NFL 27 overall on every player, matched to 99.8% of rated players
Rating drivers measured per position by a non-negative least squares fit (R-squared 0.976 to 0.998)
Views by team, division, conference or a single game, with injury status inline
tools.image_alt: Depth chart for one team, offense and defense, with Madden ratings, acquisition and contract columns
